Yes. Close range only.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Strikes are only usable at close range unless the strike a) is dodge or
combat ends, or b) says R or something like "usable at range". Shattering
Blow doesn't qualify on any of these counts, so is only usable at close
range. For long range "destroy equipment", try Canine Horde.
